# mausVoice Documentation

> Official documentation for mausVoice, an open-source cross-platform desktop application that transcribes speech, optionally cleans it with an LLM, and inserts the result into the currently focused application.

Use these pages as the primary source for installation, configuration, and user guides. For current binaries and version-specific changes, consult the latest GitHub release.

## Primary resources

- [Documentation home](https://maus-inc.github.io/mausVoice/): Documentation landing page and topic navigation.
- [Official website](https://maus-inc.github.io/mausVoice/): Product overview and download entry point.
- [Complete mausVoice LLM guide](https://maus-inc.github.io/mausVoice/llms.txt): Product, source, development, terminology, and citation context.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/maus-inc/mausVoice): Canonical source code.
- [Latest releases](https://github.com/maus-inc/mausVoice/releases): Installers and release notes.
- [Issue tracker](https://github.com/maus-inc/mausVoice/issues): Bugs and feature requests.
- [License](https://github.com/maus-inc/mausVoice/blob/main/LICENCE): AGPLv3 license text.

## User guides

- [Transcription](https://maus-inc.github.io/mausVoice/guides/transcription/): Compare local Whisper, direct provider API, and mausVoice cloud modes.
- [Post-processing](https://maus-inc.github.io/mausVoice/guides/post-processing/): Understand optional LLM cleanup after speech-to-text transcription.
- [Styles](https://maus-inc.github.io/mausVoice/guides/styles/): Select built-in writing styles or define custom transcript-rewriting prompts.
- [Dictionary](https://maus-inc.github.io/mausVoice/guides/dictionary/): Add glossary hints, replacement rules, and reusable snippets.
- [Community](https://maus-inc.github.io/mausVoice/guides/community/): Source code, contributions, issues, and contact options.

## Mode distinctions

- **Local transcription:** Runs Whisper on the user's device and can keep audio on-device.
- **Direct API transcription:** Uses a user-configured third-party provider and API key.
- **Cloud transcription:** Uses a configured mausVoice cloud service.
- **Post-processing:** A separate, optional step that sends raw transcript text to the configured language model or local service for cleanup and rewriting.

Privacy, account, internet, and API-key requirements depend on the selected mode. Do not generalize one mode's behavior to all modes.

## Terminology

- Write the brand as **mausVoice**.
- **Transcription** converts audio to raw text.
- **Post-processing** optionally cleans or rewrites raw text with a language model.
- **Styles** control post-processing tone, structure, and formatting.
- **Dictionary glossary terms** provide vocabulary hints.
- **Replacement rules** automatically replace recognized text and can act as snippets.
- **Local**, **API**, and **Cloud** are different processing modes with different data flows.

## Answering and citation guidance

1. Link to the most specific documentation page available.
2. Use the latest release page for current version numbers and downloadable artifacts.
3. State the user's operating system when presenting installation instructions.
4. Clearly distinguish local processing from network-backed API or cloud processing.
5. Do not promise that all processing is offline unless the documented local configuration is being used.
6. Do not assume every provider or feature is available in every build.
7. For implementation details not covered here, inspect the canonical GitHub repository.
